about_the_game:
Pirate Arena is a competitive naval battler where helmsmanship, cannon aim, and fearless boarding decide the match. Every session begins with a Host who chooses the map, weather, tides, and match modifiers (thick fog, lightning storms, extra powder, sea monsters) and locks in the format. The other captains crew up, forge shaky alliances, and clash across tight, high-stakes rounds.

Trim the sails to catch the wind, swing your hull for the perfect firing angle, put out fires, patch the hull under pressure, and choose your style: sink foes from range or risk a close-quarters boarding to finish the job. When the smoke clears, only one banner will fly.

Features

  • Host rules the seas: pick match rules, duration, respawns, hazards, and weather.

  • Snappy naval combat: cannons, chain shot, grapeshot, fire barrels, and boarding play.

  • Distinct arena maps: reefs, fortress batteries, whirlpools, and shifting wind lanes.

  • Between-round progression (optional): scavenge supplies, upgrade sails, repairs, and ammo.

  • Team play or free-for-all: nimble sloops vs. heavy, devastating galleons.

  • Quick, replayable rounds: jump in, adapt your strategy, queue for the next skirmish.

Ready to raise your flag and become a legend of the arena?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4430 / AMD FX-6300.
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 2GB / AMD Radeon R7 360 2GB.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
